_about: Logic of the extras_qol plugin (tools/rando/parity/extras_qol.py). Every option here is a remake setting that is off by default, so nothing in this file is a plain OoTR override (no 'helpers' / 'regions' sections: world_settings.py applies none of it). The plugin rewrites rules through OoTR's logic reader only when the option is on, and stops the seed if a rewrite finds no rule (must_hit). remake_skip_talon: Talon starts awake at the ranch, so the castle-grounds condition OoTR puts on Malon's song, Talon's cuccos and the castle garden (at('Hyrule Castle Grounds', is_child and (Weird_Egg or Chicken)), or the plain 'Weird_Egg or Chicken' exit) becomes True, and Malon's castle egg is skipped (she has left the castle: False). remake_early_grannys_shop: Granny's shuffled item needs only the wallet her price needs (the remake's merchant scene sells it at her first talk). remake_slingshot_beehives: the Slingshot breaks hives (Obj_Beehive SlingshotBullet damage rate set to 1). remake_damage_multiplier x8 / x16: OoTR's "damage_multiplier != 'ohko'" tests read False (the logic treats both as one-hit KO).
